name: Krebs Biochemicals & Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, Krebs Biochemicals & Industries Ltd is presently engaged in manufacturing of active pharmaceutical ingredients.
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio
a) Androstenedione which is used as Steroid Intermediate
b) Lovastatin used as Anti-cholesterol medication
c) Simvastatin is also used as Anti-cholesterol medication
d) Upcoming Products: Amlodipine, Cetirizine, Orlistat, Telmisartan, Serratiopepetidase and Phenylephrine. [1]

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 5.33% over past five years.
